chapter_seo_title: Dao-Twisted World Chapter 106: The Rot of Greed at Anci Nunnery
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang leads his group to Anci Nunnery, only to find nuns drowning in rotting food and unending gluttony. The price for Layue Shiba may be higher than he thinks.
og_description: A temple of filth, vomit, and pure gluttony. Li Huowang’s deal for Layue Shiba takes a grotesque turn.
